metadata.note: Firing order 1-3-7-2-6-5-4-8, equal intervals; cylinders 1-4 the right bank, 5-8 the left. Each bank's 4-into-1 manifold (primaries about 0.20 and 0.16 m, x 48 mm from 42 mm; the front two of each bank taken as the long ones, an estimate), its downpipe (right 0.20 m, left 0.50 m; which bank's is the longer is not settled by the diagrams, and the left is taken), a chamber with the wool (0.52 m x 165 mm, 11.1 L), 0.08 m, a chamber (0.42 m x 135 mm, 6.0 L) and 1.40 m to the rear chamber, where the banks first meet (0.54 m x 168 mm, 12.0 L); its two tailpipes (55 mm inside, owners' measurement) as one of their combined area (0.30 m x 89 mm). Collector to outlet 3.46 m (right) and 3.76 m (left); the chambers 46.2 L, 9.3 times the displacement, in place of the catalysts and the centre and rear silencers. Pipes 59 mm from the downpipes' 52 mm inside (owners' measurement). Lengths are estimates from eurospares' parts diagrams 202-000, -005 and -010 (about +-20 %). The pipes' diameters are the real car's inner diameters times 1.14, the primaries' included; the expansion chambers' (silencers' bodies') sizes and places, the 1.14 and the 20 mm of wool were set by ear (K, 2026-11-22). Lengths are in steps of 0.02 m. Valve: the two 33 mm exhaust valves (a parts vendor) as one of their combined area, open about 240 deg seat to seat (a cam regrinder's figure quoted on a forum; 195 deg at 1 mm lift in Porsche's table).
